jobs.prompt: Minimalist illustration on a pure black background, clean thin white line art with no shading, white lines only, no colour at all. People, animals and objects are drawn WHITE: white bodies, white clothes, white fills, never black-filled shapes or dark silhouettes. No text, letters or captions in the image. Vertical 9:16 composition. Setting: a classroom in thin white line art: a blackboard, wooden desks. Scene: a teacher, a man drawn all in WHITE with glasses, short hair, a plain WHITE t-shirt and WHITE trousers, stands at the front of the class smiling wisely, holding a glass of water up at shoulder height in one hand, the other arm relaxed at his side, both feet flat on the floor. Normal human anatomy: each person has exactly two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet. Each leg runs from the hip to ONE foot, the feet point the same way as the knees, no third foot or extra leg, and the legs of different people never merge or overlap; people in the background stand clearly apart from each other.
